theorem iso_lemma1 :
    ∀ (g : Grid) (color repl : Nat) (useMin : Bool),
      repl ≠ color →
      countColor (consumeRowExtremal g color repl useMin) color ≤ countColor g color := by
  sorry

theorem iso_lemma2 :
    ∀ (g : Grid) (dy dx : Int),
      countColor (translateBlock g [9, 12] dy dx [3] 3 2) 11 ≤ countColor g 11 := by
  sorry
chain:
theorem iso_chain (g : Grid) (a t : Nat) :
    countColor (specStep g a t) 11 ≤ countColor g 11 := by
  by_cases h0 : a = 0
  · rw [specStep, if_pos h0]
    exact Nat.le_trans (iso_lemma1 _ 11 3 true (by decide)) (iso_lemma2 g (-5 : Int) (0 : Int))
  · by_cases h1 : a = 1
    · rw [specStep, if_neg h0, if_pos h1]
      exact Nat.le_trans (iso_lemma1 _ 11 3 true (by decide)) (iso_lemma2 g (5 : Int) (0 : Int))
    · by_cases h2 : a = 2
      · rw [specStep, if_neg h0, if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
        exact Nat.le_trans (iso_lemma1 _ 11 3 true (by decide)) (iso_lemma2 g (0 : Int) (-5 : Int))
      · rw [specStep, if_neg h0, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
        exact Nat.le_trans (iso_lemma1 _ 11 3 true (by decide)) (iso_lemma2 g (0 : Int) (5 : Int))

theorem iso_lemma1_row_count_le :
    ∀ (row : List Nat) (color repl : Nat) (useMin : Bool),
      repl ≠ color →
      ((let idxs := (List.range row.length).filter (fun x => row.getD x 0 == color)
        match (if useMin then idxs.head? else idxs.getLast?) with
        | none => row
        | some k => (List.range row.length).map fun x => if x = k then repl else row.getD x 0
       ).filter (fun v => v == color)).length ≤
        (row.filter (fun v => v == color)).length := by
  sorry

theorem iso_lemma2_grid_count_le_of_row_count_le :
    ∀ (g : Grid) (f : List Nat → List Nat) (color : Nat),
      (∀ row ∈ g, ((f row).filter (fun v => v == color)).length ≤
        (row.filter (fun v => v == color)).length) →
      countColor (g.map f) color ≤ countColor g color := by
  sorry
chain:
theorem iso_chain : ∀ (g : Grid) (color repl : Nat) (useMin : Bool),
      repl ≠ color →
      countColor (consumeRowExtremal g color repl useMin) color ≤ countColor g color := by
  intro g color repl useMin hne
  unfold consumeRowExtremal
  exact iso_lemma2_grid_count_le_of_row_count_le
    g
    (fun row =>
      let idxs := (List.range row.length).filter (fun x => row.getD x 0 == color)
      match (if useMin then idxs.head? else idxs.getLast?) with
      | none => row
      | some k => (List.range row.length).map fun x => if x = k then repl else row.getD x 0)
    color
    (by
      intro row hrow
      exact iso_lemma1_row_count_le row color repl useMin hne)

theorem balanced_journal_conservation_zero_endpoint_and_separate_sharpness_conj1 : ∀ {Account : Type u} [Fintype Account] [DecidableEq Account], ∀ (ledger : Ledger Account) {journal : Journal Account},
    (∀ entry ∈ journal, BalancedEntry entry) →
      totalBalance (postJournal ledger journal) = totalBalance ledger ∧
        (totalBalance ledger = 0 → totalBalance (postJournal ledger journal) = 0) := by sorry

theorem balanced_journal_conservation_zero_endpoint_and_separate_sharpness_conj2 : ∀ {Account : Type u} [Fintype Account] [DecidableEq Account], ∀ (ledger : Ledger Account) (account : Account) {amount : ℤ},
    amount ≠ 0 →
      ¬BalancedEntry [{ account := account, amount := amount }] ∧
        totalBalance (applyEntry ledger [{ account := account, amount := amount }]) ≠ totalBalance ledger := by sorry
chain:
theorem balanced_journal_conservation_zero_endpoint_and_separate_sharpness {Account : Type u} [Fintype Account] [DecidableEq Account] :
    (∀ (ledger : Ledger Account) {journal : Journal Account},
      (∀ entry ∈ journal, BalancedEntry entry) →
        totalBalance (postJournal ledger journal) = totalBalance ledger ∧
          (totalBalance ledger = 0 →
            totalBalance (postJournal ledger journal) = 0)) ∧
      (∀ (ledger : Ledger Account) (account : Account) {amount : Int},
        amount ≠ 0 →
          ¬ BalancedEntry ([{ account := account, amount := amount }] : Entry Account) ∧
            totalBalance
                (applyEntry ledger ([{ account := account, amount := amount }] : Entry Account)) ≠
              totalBalance ledger) := by
  repeat' apply And.intro
  all_goals solve_by_elim [balanced_journal_conservation_zero_endpoint_and_separate_sharpness_conj1, balanced_journal_conservation_zero_endpoint_and_separate_sharpness_conj2]

theorem iso_lemma1_row_map_count_le
    (g : Grid) (f : List Nat → List Nat) (color : Nat)
    (h : ∀ row ∈ g,
      ((f row).filter (fun v => v = color)).length ≤
        (row.filter (fun v => v = color)).length) :
    countColor (g.map f) color ≤ countColor g color := by sorry

theorem iso_lemma2_specStep_row_factor
    (g : Grid) (a t : Nat) :
    ∃ f : List Nat → List Nat,
      specStep g a t = g.map f ∧
      ∀ row ∈ g,
        ((f row).filter (fun v => v = 4)).length ≤
          (row.filter (fun v => v = 4)).length := by sorry
chain:
theorem iso_chain (g : Grid) (a t : Nat) :
    countColor (specStep g a t) 4 ≤ countColor g 4 := by
  obtain ⟨f, hstep, hrow⟩ := iso_lemma2_specStep_row_factor g a t
  rw [hstep]
  exact iso_lemma1_row_map_count_le g f 4 hrow

theorem iso_lemma1 (g : Grid) (a t : Nat) :
    (∀ row ∈ specStep g a t,
      (row.filter (fun v => v = 8)).length ≤ countColor g 8) ∧
    (specStep g a t).length ≤ 1 := by sorry

theorem iso_lemma3_aggregate_bound
    (out input : Grid) (color : Nat)
    (hrows : ∀ row ∈ out,
      (row.filter (fun v => v = color)).length ≤ countColor input color)
    (hcard : out.length ≤ 1) :
    countColor out color ≤ countColor input color := by sorry

theorem iso_lemma4_step_has_at_most_one_row (g : Grid) (a t : Nat)
    (h : (∀ row ∈ specStep g a t,
      (row.filter (fun v => v = 8)).length ≤ countColor g 8) ∧
      (specStep g a t).length ≤ 1) :
    (specStep g a t).length ≤ 1 := by sorry
chain:
theorem iso_chain (g : Grid) (a t : Nat) :
    countColor (specStep g a t) 8 ≤ countColor g 8 := by
  apply iso_lemma3_aggregate_bound
  · exact (iso_lemma1 g a t).1
  · exact iso_lemma4_step_has_at_most_one_row g a t (iso_lemma1 g a t)
